claim: OpenLine compiles untrusted optimizer proposals plus receiver-owned mandate, state, policy, and verified evidence into non-executable settings for existing Verified Commit authorization.
production_safety: optimizer cannot supply mandate or receiver resolvers at compile time
mandate is checked before evidence resolution
authorization lifetime is clamped to mandate and selected-evidence standing
compiler result has no execution authority
AuthorityCompiler.execute_once always installs receiver-owned fresh preflight before side effect
existing Verified Commit retains exact-action, one-use, and replay enforcement
